overview: The paper proposes FlowReg, a regularization technique for reinforcement learning that aligns an agent's latent state embeddings with smooth Neural ODE flows to enforce topological consistency with environment dynamics, evaluated on Atari and Minigrid environments using A2C and PPO algorithms.

modules.name: Neural ODE Flow Model
modules.description: Implementation of the Neural ODE parameterized by a multi-layer perceptron with specific activation functions, defining the latent state derivative, and integrating the ODE solver to compute continuous flow trajectories from initial latent states.

modules.name: Target Agent Architecture
modules.description: Construction of the Actor-Critic architecture featuring an explicit state embedder (e.g., Nature CNN for Atari, MLP for Minigrid) to map semantic states to latent vectors, along with separate policy and value heads for action distribution and state-value estimation.

modules.name: Time Sampling Strategies
modules.description: Implementation of discrete time-index assignment schemes for MDP trajectory states to serve as integration times for the ODE solver, including step-index mapping and discounted exponential-decay mapping.

modules.name: FlowReg Alignment Loss
modules.description: Computation of the mean squared error between the discrete latent point sequence generated by the agent's semantic embedder and the continuous flow path sampled from the Neural ODE, enforcing topological alignment.

modules.name: Joint Training Objective
modules.description: Aggregation of the standard Actor-Critic losses (policy gradient and value function error) with the flow regularization loss, applying appropriate weighting coefficients to form the overall optimization target.

modules.name: RL Environment Wrappers
modules.description: Custom environment wrappers for Atari and Minigrid domains to handle frame preprocessing, grayscale conversion, resizing, frame stacking, and importantly, tracking episode IDs to ensure trajectory continuity for flow computation.

modules.name: Trajectory Rollout Buffer
modules.description: A specialized replay buffer for on-policy algorithms that stores state trajectories, actions, rewards, and episode IDs, enabling the extraction of consecutive state sequences required for calculating latent path sequences and ODE initial values.

modules.name: A2C Training Loop
modules.description: The Advantage Actor-Critic training pipeline, managing the collection of rollouts, advantage estimation, and performing periodic parameter updates including the decoupled FlowReg updates at specified frequencies relative to agent updates.

modules.name: PPO Training Loop
modules.description: The Proximal Policy Optimization training pipeline for discrete gridworld environments, integrating the clipped surrogate objective with the periodic FlowReg loss computation and backpropagation.

modules.name: Optimization Utilities
modules.description: Configuration of the RMSProp optimizer, learning rate linear decay scheduler, and global-norm gradient clipping mechanisms to ensure stable training for both the agent and the Neural ODE networks.

modules.name: Episodic Reward Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluation scripts to compute mean episode rewards, standard deviations across multiple random seeds, and rolling average performance metrics for benchmarking against baseline algorithms.

modules.name: Latent Smoothness Evaluation
modules.description: Implementation of geometric metrics to assess latent trajectory quality, specifically calculating path length, net displacement, and acceleration energy (second-difference in position) normalized by trajectory length.

modules.name: Baseline and Ablation Implementations
modules.description: Integration of standard Actor-Critic baselines and alternative temporal consistency regularization methods like TACO, serving as control variables for comparative performance and smoothness analysis.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sweep Framework
modules.description: Experiment configuration scripts to conduct grid searches over FlowReg-specific hyperparameters, including time sampling modes, update frequencies relative to the agent, and regularization loss weights.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Profiling
modules.description: Instrumentation to measure and compare the runtime overhead, total training time, and step-wise computational cost introduced by the ODE solver against baseline training durations.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: YAML/JSON parsing utilities for defining and inheriting experiment configurations, managing environment identifiers, algorithm variants, and FlowReg hyperparameter setups across multiple seeds and environments.

modules.name: Logging and Model Persistence
modules.description: Integration with experiment tracking dashboards for logging training curves and evaluation metrics, alongside utilities for saving and loading model checkpoints for the agent embedder, heads, and the Neural ODE flow model.
